intent: Today screen redesign comp for an ACNH diary app. The screen separates automatic daily island context from direct user recording controls.
layout: Top header shows island/date/time context only.
Today summary board contains automatic facts: birthday, seasonal recipes/materials, zodiac, tree/material prompt, current event, monthly critter movement.
Daily routines are icon-first tap controls.
Weekly visiting NPC is a separate recording strip, not part of the summary.
Catchable now prioritizes critters that are uncaught or caught-but-undonated. Full view includes completed critters too.
Calendar is reduced to a compact schedule preview so it does not duplicate the summary.
assetPlan: Replace placeholder routine symbols with official or locally cached game item icons.
Replace NPC emoji placeholders with NPC face assets.
Replace critter emoji placeholders with existing encyclopedia thumbnail assets.
openQuestions: Whether Today should show 4 or 6 routine controls above the fold by default.
Whether catchable-now full view should be a full-screen route or a tall modal sheet.
